messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "tell healthcare provider immediately if given by injection"
set: ["tell healthcare provider immediately if given by injection", "healthcare provider gives injection if unable to take by mouth", "stop taking if pregnant and call healthcare provider immediately", "tell healthcare provider if mouth effects are severe", "tell healthcare provider if taking prescription or over-the-counter medicines", "tell healthcare provider if taking vitamins or herbal supplements", "healthcare provider may teach you how to properly use the injection by yourself", "injected into a vein by a healthcare provider", "take exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider", "take prescribed dose as indicated by healthcare provider", "tell healthcare provider if someone in household has abused drugs", "tell healthcare provider if living in household with small children", "stop taking and call healthcare provider immediately for severe stomach pain", "stop taking and tell doctor immediately if pregnant", "stop using and tell doctor immediately if pregnant", "call your healthcare provider if this happens"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
